notice: Draft configuration for the Crew Health Check potency engine. Every value carries its basis and source IDs (research notes in reports/crew-health-medications-2026-11-14/research). team_default values are placeholders that the named role must replace before operational use.

temperature_k.note: ICH Q1A(R2) long-term storage temperature, 25 C.

relative_humidity_percent.note: Midpoint of the Du 2011 ground-control chamber (36 to 44 %RH). Calibration integrates internal package RH before conversion to this reference.

activation_energy_j_per_mol.note: USP default heat of activation for MKT (dH/R = 10000 K). Display only.

duration_s.note: 30-day rolling window for controlled room temperature (USP <1079.2> as reported secondhand).
24-hour window for cold-chain products (USP <1079.2> as reported secondhand).

coverage_probability.note: Coverage probability of the reported interval; matches the 5th and 95th percentiles used by decisions.

n_dig.note: JCGM 101 7.9.2: significant decimal digits for the numerical tolerance.

max_batches.note: Upper bound on adaptive batches (10^6 draws at p = 0.90).

min_batches.note: JCGM 101 7.9.4 needs at least two batch results for a standard deviation.

lower_quantile.note: Lower quantile compared with the lower specification limit (design brief decision).

upper_quantile.note: Upper quantile compared with the upper specification limit (design brief decision).

degradant_quantile.note: Quantile of each tracked degradant compared with its limit.

ess_floor.note: Minimum effective sample size after assay reweighting before batches are added.

conflict_tail_probability.note: Two-sided prior-predictive tail probability below which an assay conflicts with the model.

ground_inter_laboratory_sd_percent.note: Extra standard deviation for ground laboratory assays (between-laboratory component).

onboard_method_sd_percent.note: Extra standard deviation for onboard assays (unvalidated method).

ln_k_sd_per_kelvin.note: Model-form standard deviation of ln k added per kelvin outside the validated temperature range.

ln_k_sd_per_percent_rh.note: Model-form standard deviation of ln k added per %RH outside the validated humidity range.

flag_share_threshold.note: Share of nominal Theta accrued outside the validated range that raises outside_validated_range.

max_time_extrapolation_ratio.note: ICH Q1E: extrapolated shelf life up to twice the period covered by long-term data.

share_threshold.note: A pathway contributes to the estimate basis when its nominal share of Theta is at least this.

rate_law_defaults.note: Du 2011 control series are consistent with first order; class priors are first-order fits.
Reference solution studies are pseudo-first order at kit-relevant concentrations.
No suspension data in the notes; first order assumed.
Du 2011 semisolid control series fitted first order.

window_s.note: Last 30 days of recorded conditions repeat into the future.

dose_rate_safety_factor.note: Sterilization data are delivered at 0.1 to 1 Gy/s, about 10^9 times the habitat dose rate; the upper bound multiplies the dose by 10 to cover unknown dose-rate effects (DERIVED in degradation-science.md section 5).

radiosensitive_dose_threshold_gy.note: Highest cumulative dose tested on kit solids without effect (GCRSim, 864.4 to 932.4 mGy); radiosensitive products beyond it are flagged as untested.

rdkit_embed_seed.note: ETKDGv3 random seed for every conformer embedding.

xtb_n_conformers.note: ETKDGv3 conformers embedded per molecule; the lowest-energy optimized parent and the lowest-energy radical built from any parent conformer are used (spec 7.4).

xtb_spin_polarization_scale.note: Scale of tblite's spin-polarization interaction for open-shell species (radical and H atom); 1 is the published parametrization, 0 turns it off (spec 7.4).

same_molecule_sd_log10.note: Ingredient identical to the anchor molecule: formulation and package differences only.

unparameterized_substituent_sd_log10.note: Added when a substituent has no constant.

ortho_substituent_sd_log10.note: Added for ortho substituents (Hammett does not apply).

heteroaromatic_ring_sd_log10.note: Added when the reacting ring is heteroaromatic.

series_relative_tolerance.note: Stopping tolerance of the humidity-integral series.

inverse_absolute_tolerance.note: Absolute tolerance on alpha for bracketed inverses (D2, D4).

small_alpha_series_threshold.note: Below this alpha the D2 and D4 inverses start from their series.

worker_threads.note: Thread-pool workers for fixed segment chunks; 0 uses the CPU count. Partial sums are reduced in chunk order.

compression_relative_tolerance.note: Maximum relative pathway Theta error on the fixed support-spanning probe set per estimate; exceeding it selects exact evaluation.

temperature_below_min_margin_k.note: Measured models include storage down to the study minimum minus this margin. The upper limit is unchanged.

dose_upper_mg.note: ICH Q3B(R2) maximum daily dose band upper boundary.

percent.note: ICH Q3B(R2) Attachment 1; decimals are the precision of the threshold as written in this unit.
